metadata.title: Imiti Gakondo n'Ibicuruzwa by'Umwimerere i Musanze
metadata.description: Imbaraga z'Igisura itanga imiti gakondo n'ibicuruzwa by'umwimerere i Musanze, mu Rwanda, hafi ya Gare ya Musanze. Dufite uburambe bw'imyaka irenga {years}. Duhamagare cyangwa utwandikire kuri WhatsApp.

common.whatsappMessage: Muraho {name}, nifuzaga amakuru ku bicuruzwa byanyu.

hero.title: Ubumenyi gakondo. Ibicuruzwa by'umwimerere. Imyaka irenga {years} y'icyizere.
hero.description: Menya imiti gakondo n'ibicuruzwa by'umwimerere dutanga, kandi utuvugishe ako kanya kuri WhatsApp cyangwa kuri telefoni. Twishimiye kugufasha kubona icyo ukeneye.

products.title: Menya ibicuruzwa byacu
products.description: Reba imiti gakondo n'ibicuruzwa by'umwimerere dutanga.
products.emptyDescription: Amakuru ku bicuruzwa, ingano zabyo n'ibiciro bizashyirwa hano. Hagati aho, twandikire tukubwire ibihari.

why.title: Kuki wahitamo Imbaraga z'Igisura?
why.experienceText: Tumaze imyaka irenga {years} dutanga imiti gakondo n'ibicuruzwa by'umwimerere.
why.naturalText: Imiti gakondo n'ibicuruzwa by'umwimerere, buri kimwe gifite amakuru asobanutse.
why.personalText: Uvugana natwe ubwacu. Dufata umwanya wo gusubiza ibibazo byawe ku bicuruzwa byacu.
why.visitText: Ngwino ku iduka ryacu tuganire imbonankubone.

order.title: Uko wabona ibicuruzwa byacu
order.step1Text: Reba ibicuruzwa byacu hano, cyangwa utubaze ibihari.
order.step2Text: Twandikire kuri WhatsApp cyangwa uduhamagare. Tuzasubiza ibibazo byawe kandi twemeze ibyo utumije.
order.step3Text: Fata ibyo watumije ku iduka ryacu i Musanze, cyangwa utubaze niba bishobora kukoherezwa.
order.deliveryText: Bitewe n'aho uherereye n'ingano y'ibyo watumije, ibicuruzwa bishobora koherezwa mu modoka zitwara abagenzi ziva i Musanze zijya i Kigali cyangwa ahandi. Ni wowe wifatira ipaki igihe igeze.
order.deliveryNote: Banza utwandikire tumenye niba bishoboka aho uri. Uburyo bwo kohereza, igihe n'ikiguzi tubyumvikanaho nawe.

info.title: Menya neza icyo ugura
info.description: Buri gicuruzwa kizagira paji igaragaza amakuru ahari kuri cyo, kugira ngo uhitemo ufite amakuru ahagije.
info.name: Izina ry'igicuruzwa
info.note: Amakuru ku mikoreshereze gakondo ashingiye ku bumenyi gakondo n'uburambe bwacu. Ntabwo ari isuzuma rya muganga cyangwa isezerano ry'umusaruro. Niba utwite, ufata indi miti cyangwa ufite ikibazo cy'ubuzima, banza ugishe inama umuganga.

about.title: Umuryango utanga imiti gakondo i Musanze
about.text1: Imbaraga z'Igisura itanga imiti gakondo n'ibicuruzwa by'umwimerere i Musanze, mu Rwanda.
about.text2: Mu myaka irenga {years}, twiyemeje gufasha buri mukiriya gusobanukirwa n'ibicuruzwa tumuha: icyo ari cyo, uko bikoreshwa mu buryo gakondo n'uko yabikoresha.

contact.title: Ufite ikibazo?
contact.description: Tuvugishe ako kanya, tugufashe kubona amakuru ukeneye.

location.title: Aho turi n'amasaha y'akazi
location.directionsNote: Ikarita igaragaza Gare ya Musanze. Iduka ryacu riri hafi yayo.

final.title: Wifuza kumenya byinshi?
final.description: Reba ibicuruzwa byacu cyangwa uvugane na {name} ako kanya.

dashboard.title: Ibiro
dashboard.intro: Cunga ibicuruzwa n'ibyiciro bigaragara ku rubuga.
dashboard.howTo1: Fungura Ibicuruzwa uhitemo igiri gutegurwa, cyangwa ukore igicuruzwa gishya.
dashboard.howTo2: Andika izina n'amakuru mu Kinyarwanda no mu Cyongereza (ururimi rumwe rurahagije ku giri gutegurwa).
dashboard.howTo3: Ongeramo amafoto nyakuri, hanyuma ingano n'ibiciro niba byemejwe.
dashboard.howTo4: Shyira uko gihagaze kuri Cyashyizwe ahagaragara hanyuma ubike. Kigaragara ku rubuga mu minota mike.

productForm.createIntro: Tangira n'izina. Amafoto, ingano n'ibiciro uzabyongeramo ku rupapuro rukurikira.
productForm.translationsHint: Uzuza indimi zombi igihe bishoboka. Igiri gutegurwa gishobora kubikwa n'ururimi rumwe; urubuga rugaragaza urundi rurimi kugeza gihinduwe.
productForm.name: Izina
productForm.shortDescriptionHelp: Interuro imwe cyangwa ebyiri zigaragara ku makarita y'ibicuruzwa.
productForm.traditionalUseHelp: Uko igicuruzwa gikoreshwa mu buryo gakondo. Ntukemeze ko gikiza cyangwa umusaruro w'ubuvuzi.
productForm.statusHelp: Ibyashyizwe ahagaragara ni byo byonyine bigaragara ku rubuga.
productForm.availabilityHelp: Bireke kuri "Ntibigaragazwe" keretse ubihindura buri gihe.
productForm.deleteText: Bisiba burundu igicuruzwa, ingano zacyo n'amafoto yacyo. Kugira ngo ugihishe by'agateganyo, shyira uko gihagaze kuri Kiri gutegurwa cyangwa Cyabitswe.
productForm.deleteConfirm: Gusiba burundu iki gicuruzwa n'amafoto yacyo yose?

variants.title: Ingano n'ibiciro
variants.intro: Umurongo umwe kuri buri ngano. Siga igiciro ubusa niba gitangwa ubajijwe; ntikigaragazwa nka 0.
variants.label: Izina ry'ingano (si ngombwa)
variants.empty: Nta ngano zirashyirwamo. Urubuga rugaragaza "Baza igiciro".

images.title: Amafoto
images.intro: Koresha amafoto nyakuri y'igicuruzwa gusa. JPG, PNG, WebP cyangwa AVIF. Amafoto manini ya telefoni agabanywa ubwayo mbere yo koherezwa.

products.metaDescription: Ibirungo, amavuta akomoka ku bimera, ubunyobwa, inzuzi, icyayi n'ibindi bicuruzwa by'umwimerere bya Imbaraga z'Igisura i Musanze, mu Rwanda.
products.title: Ibicuruzwa by'umwimerere
products.intro: Ibirungo, amavuta akomoka ku bimera, ubunyobwa, inzuzi, icyayi n'ibindi. Ibiciro n'ingano bigaragazwa iyo byemejwe. Ku bindi byose, tubaze kuri WhatsApp.

products.noResultsText: Gerageza irindi jambo, reba uko wanditse, cyangwa uhitemo ikindi cyiciro. Ushobora no kutubaza ako kanya.
products.errorText: Reba niba murandasi ikora, hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
products.helpText: Mu iduka dufite ibindi byinshi kurusha ibiri hano. Twandikire tukubwire ibihari.

productPage.traditionalUseNote: Ibi bisobanura uko igicuruzwa gikoreshwa mu buryo gakondo. Si umusaruro wemejwe n'ubuvuzi.
productPage.askText: Twandikire kuri WhatsApp. Izina ry'igicuruzwa n'umurongo wacyo byongerwamo ubwabyo.
productPage.translationNote: Amakuru y'iki gicuruzwa ntaraboneka mu Kinyarwanda.
productPage.healthNote: Amakuru ku mikoreshereze gakondo si isuzuma rya muganga cyangwa isezerano ry'umusaruro. Niba utwite, ufata indi miti cyangwa ufite ikibazo cy'ubuzima, banza ugishe inama umuganga.
